test_title: PYST 51: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 8th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: If P earns 331over3% less than Q, then how much per cent does Q earn more than P?
solution:
**Given:**

P/Q = 2/3 (33.33% = 1/3)

**Formula used:**

Percentage less/more = (A - B)/B × 100

**Calculation:**

Percentage by which Q earns more than P = (3 - 2)/2 × 100

⇒ 50%

∴ Thus Q earn **50% **more than P.
